content.short: Arbitrary Execution protects Web3 protocols, assets, and users with continuous security solutions.
content.description: Arbitrary Execution is an engineering-focused organization dedicated to securing decentralized technology. Its security researchers apply offensive security techniques and a hacker mindset to defend the Web3 ecosystem. The team has completed more than 45 audits of Web3 protocols and projects, developed tools that monitor the blockchain for anomalous activity, and introduced the Web3 SDLC—a practical framework for integrating security throughout the development life cycle. This approach blends rigorous assessment with ongoing monitoring to support secure design, development, and deployment across Web3 initiatives.
content.meta: Arbitrary Execution is an engineering-focused Web3 security organization. Discover Arbitrary Execution and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
